description: Type the 409 POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services answers when the organization already has as many services as its plan allows: {"status": 409, "error": "INSTANCE_LIMIT_REACHED"}. The spec documents no 409 on createService, so it surfaced as the generic Conflict. Observed live 2026-11-12 on a trial organization that already had its two services (request id 86382d05-4229-49f6-a37a-31cf34fe9953).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The organization has as many services as its plan allows (`INSTANCE_LIMIT_REACHED`). Delete a service or raise the `services-per-organization` quota, then retry.
